{{Attr|Tank}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Nulling''' was an enemy that appeared in the [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]] and [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. ==Logbook Description== "''A Nulling lurks in the depths of the Nil Zone, concealed within its vast emptiness, surviving by hunting other creatures that dwell there. These weak, unremarkable enemies instinctively follow more powerful beings. They also like to decorate themselves with whatever scraps they can find.''" ==Appearance== The '''Nulling''' is a purple creature with two differently sized horns, four yellow eyes and claws on its arms and legs. It wears a grey chestplate, shoulder-pads, knee-pad and bandages, and a purple scarf around its neck. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *The '''Nulling''' is quite weak, meaning most early-game towers can handle it. **Single target towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]] or [[Cowboy]] can be used. **AOE towers like the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Military Base]] or [[Mortar]] can clear these out quite well, as it generally spawns in hordes. *Later on, the '''Nulling''' becomes rather weak, meaning most towers should be capable of defeating them, including late-game towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Golden Minigunner]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNulling.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (4 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNulling2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (4 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNulling3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, third animation variant (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Null&VoidNight1PI.png|'''Nulling''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - Halloween 2025 Trailer|'''Nulling''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Null & Void Event Night 1 All Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Nulling''' in the [[Outpost 16]] cutscenes. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NullingIconIG.png|'''Nulling''' on its [[Index]] icon.
